# The base map

## A base map of the Indian legal system

- Courts, court-adjacent bodies, and court-support bodies
- Relationships: appellate, appointments, funds, and others
- Every entity carries detail: year created or abolished, cases pending, seats vacant
- Rubrics on the entity itself: independence risk, case clog, and others

::: {.notes}
Part of the 2-minute glimpse with the next two slides. Do not walk every bullet. The point is that JEM is a map of institutions and the links between them, with a rubric on each node.
:::
